source: 659 local Pi session logs; 29,936 edit and 12,495 write tool calls. Raw edits are not stored in this repo.

weakens_test.label_rule: edit to a test file that removes assertions or adds skip/todo = bad; edit that keeps or adds assertions = good. Labels come from code, not judgment.
weakens_test.split: by session; holdout sessions never seen during tuning

undone_later.label_rule: bad = a third or more of the added lines were removed or rewritten by the agent within the next 10 tool calls on the same file; good = survived 10 or more later tool calls
undone_later.finding: No yes/no question predicted which writes get undone (dev AUC 0.48 to 0.60). Size, tool and file type baselines were no better (0.43 to 0.56). This task is not shipped.
